description: Prompt injection detection / scanner for untrusted text before an LLM agent reads it (web pages, emails, documents, tool output). Rule-based scan of up to 50 KB for instruction-override phrases, system-prompt reveal requests, DAN-style jailbreaks, hidden or bidi unicode, base64-encoded instructions and tool/markdown-image exfiltration. Returns risk (none to critical), matches with offsets and a sanitized copy. Heuristic; text not stored. Price: 0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).
name: injection_scan
